{{Quote
|Hr = Journal
|Aerial worker lost to Pharloom's Haunting. Bears a pouch full with flintstone which they will fling at intruders.<hr/>That incendiary material they carry is a natural wonder, with many potential applications. What a waste to carelessly throw it at me whenever I pass by.
}}

<b>Flintstone Flyers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are winged [[Dock Workers|workers]] of the [[Deep Docks]] that throw [[Flintstone]] at intruders.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Flintstone Flyers either fly in place or are at work, until [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] approaches or attacks, at which point they begin targeting her.<br>
Being flying enemies, Flintstone Flyers try to maintain distance from Hornet, attempting to remain diagonally distanced from her at all times.<br>
To attack, they throw a Flintstone at Hornet which travels in an arc and bounces off surfaces before fizzling out and becoming harmless.<br>
Their bell helmets make them completely immune to Needle Bounces, which only stun them momentarily instead of dealing damage.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Flintstone Flyers have their health quadrupled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

A Flintstone Flyer with only 20 HP can be seen listening to [[Forebrothers Signis & Gron|Forebrother Signis]] before his boss fight.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* For grace above...
* Smelt dug and churned...
* Toil, and toil, and toil...
* Tunnel, breach, bore...
* Seek the shine... find the ore...
* By holy light...
}}

== Location ==
Flintstone Flyers can be found exclusively in the [[Deep Docks]], including the entrance to it from [[the Marrow]]. They can also be summoned by [[Forebrother Signis]].
